greeting.text: The salt wind bites hard today. Did the tide bring you in, drowned one? The Norman coast has buried better men than you.

settlement.text: Follow the cliffside cobble past the Old Lighthouse. Our bastion lies across the bay. Keep your weapon drawn; the blighted things crawl from the kelp at dusk.

inland.text: Past the dunes lie the Witchbane Watch and the crumbling roads of the Choir. Don't wander into the mist unless you've rekindled your Ember Flask.
